column3: “that through her I too may have children” renders “that I too may be built up from her.”
“mighty wrestlings” renders “wrestlings of God,” and “Naphtali” sounds like “I have wrestled.”
“How fortunate!” follows the reading tradition (“fortune has come”); “Gad” means “fortune.”
“mandrakes” renders a plant thought to aid fertility.
“Joseph” sounds like “may He add” (and “taken away” in verse 23).
“If now it pleases you” renders “if now I have found favor in your eyes,” and “I have divined” may also mean “I have grown rich.”
